## Young River Dragon (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 CN Medium dragon (aquatic, fire)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** dragon senses, watersight; Perception +13  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+3 Dex, +10 natural)  
 **hp** 120 (8d12+24)  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** +9, **Will** +8  
 **Immune** fire, paralysis, sleep  
 **Weaknesses** Vulnerable to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +13 (1d8+6)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. line, DC 17, 6d6 fire)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 8th)  

 At will—*[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 19, **Dex** 17, **Con** 16, **Int** 11, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** 8; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 25 (cannot be tripped)  
 **Feats** Athletic, Cleave, Improved Initiative, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +13, Spellcraft +11, Stealth +14, Survival, +13, Swim +17  
 **Languages** Draconic  
 **SQ** air breathing, speak with aquatic, watersight  

**Special Abilities**

 **Air Breathing (Ex)**  The river dragon can breathe air just as naturally as water. This dragon can freely use its breath weapon, spells and other abilities in both air and water.  

 **Speak with Aquatic (Ex)**  The young and older river dragon gains a constant spell-like ability to *speak with animals* of the aquatic subtype. This otherwise functions as *speak with animals*.  

 **Watersight (Ex)**  The very young and older river dragon can see underwater four times better than a human.

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
